Since that peak, temperatures have dropped to 87.8°F with cloud cover increasing to BKN/100% and a 2-hour velocity of -0.9°F/hr, clearly signaling that the daily maximum has already been established. No tropical or severe weather alerts are active, though widespread afternoon/evening thunderstorms are expected.
forecast_obs_notes: HRRR (91.1°F) and ECMWF (90.2°F) came closest to the observed 91.4°F peak, while NBM (87.8°F) and the NWS narrative (~89°F) notably underestimated today's heat. All NWP models placed peak timing around 15:00 ET, consistent with the observed peak at ~14:49 ET, suggesting good timing skill even if magnitude was underforecast by some models.
